crash_costs.page: Table 2, printed p. 16 (PDF p. 22); '2024 dollars'; same values as Red Book Table 3, p. 48 [54]
rules: the NY sources give no injury level, so injury crashes (U) are unpriced: only K and O are priced

statewide_rates.missing: NYSDOT's current average crash rates are inside CLEAR Safety (login only; Red Book p. 87 [93]); the posted tables are 2017-2019 and their links are broken (research 2026-11-07); CrashIQ has no New York traffic counts

screening.state_method: Potential for Safety Improvement (Empirical Bayes excess expected crashes, or excess observed crashes where AADT is missing) focused on fatal and serious injury crashes (Red Book p. 35-40 [41-46])

min_years.page: p. 4 [10]: 'typically includes the latest three years of complete crash data'

spf_calibration.missing: NY SPFs (Red Book App. C p. 92-93 [98-99]) are applied in CLEAR Safety; no SPF engine in CrashIQ
